header.running_head: Belittling and Looking Down at a Muslim

blocks.text: Belittling and Looking Down at a Muslim
The Narrations of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), Hadhrat Ataa and Hadhrat Urwa (RA) About Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA)

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) once tripped and fell over a doorstep, causing him to sustain a gash on his head. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Aa'isha! Wipe the blood off him." When Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) felt repulsed to do it, Rasulullaah ﷺ licked the blood off Hadhrat Usaama (RA)'s wound and then spat it out. He then said, "Had Usaama been a girl, I would have adorned her with fine clothing and jewellery and got her married."[^1]

Hadhrat Ataa bin Yasaar reports that as soon as he arrived in Madinah, Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) was afflicted with smallpox. He was still a little boy and mucus often ran from his nose to his mouth. This repulsed Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ then entered the room, washed the boy's face and then kissed him. Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "By Allaah! After seeing this, I shall never distance this boy from me."[^2]

Hadhrat Urwa (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ actually delayed leaving Arafah (to proceed to Muzdalifah) because he was waiting for Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA). When Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) who was a boy with a flat nose and a black skin arrived, the people of Yemen remarked, "Was it for someone like this that we were delayed?" Hadhrat Urwa (RA) says that it was because of this statement that the people of Yemen reverted to kufr."
Hadhrat Ibn Sa'd says that he asked Hadhrat Yazeed bin Haaroon, "What did Hadhrat Urwa (RA) mean when he said that it was because of this that the people of Yemen reverted to kufr?" He replied, "Their leaving the fold of Islaam during the time of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was because they belittled the behaviour of Rasulullaah ﷺ (by waiting for Hadhrat Usaama (RA))."[^3]

Another similar narration quotes Hadhrat Urwa (RA) as saying, "After the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ, the people of Yemen reverted to kufr because of (their looking down at) Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA)."[^4]
The Statement of Hadhrat Umar (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Hasan reports that when a group of people once went to Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA), he gave something to the Arabs amongst them while giving nothing to (non-Arab) slaves.
